description: This file defines the GeoMapsClient class which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Location Service Maps V2, such as fetching glyphs, sprites, static maps, style descriptors, and tiles.

classes.name: GeoMapsClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Location Service Maps V2, providing methods to retrieve map components such as glyphs, sprites, static maps, style descriptors, and tiles.

methods.name: getGlyphs
methods.description: Retrieves glyphs data from the map service.

methods.name: getGlyphsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves glyphs data from the map service.

methods.name: getSprites
methods.description: Retrieves sprite images from the map service.

methods.name: getSpritesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves sprite images from the map service.

methods.name: getStyleDescriptor
methods.description: Fetches style descriptor data for maps.

methods.name: getTile
methods.description: Retrieves map tile images based on provided parameters.
